title: Shared documentation for AddItemSheet aisle picker persistence fix
description: Document the implementation intent and regression scope for the AddItemSheet aisle picker fix, including the move away from the custom Binding and the guarded `.onChange` approach.
acceptance_criteria: Documentation records the root cause tied to the computed custom Binding and navigationLink picker behavior.
Documentation records the new direct `$selectedAisle` binding and guarded `.onChange` strategy.
Documentation notes that EditItemSheet is intentionally unchanged and out of scope.
Documentation captures the regression scenarios validated by tests and manual verification guidance from the spec.

handoff_summary.completed: Three inline comments added to AddItemSheet.swift: (1) on isProgrammaticAisleUpdate explaining why .navigationLink Picker fires .onChange on programmatic writes, (2) on the .onChange(of: selectedAisle) handler explaining the user-vs-programmatic guard, (3) on setAisleProgrammatically() explaining it centralises all non-user writes and noting EditItemSheet is intentionally out of scope.
handoff_summary.risks: None. Only AddItemSheet.swift touched with comment-only changes; no runtime behavior altered.
handoff_summary.conflict_risks: None — only AddItemSheet.swift was modified with comment-only changes; no shared files touched.
handoff_summary.design_decisions: Chose inline code comments over a separate docs/ update because the non-obvious behavior (navigationLink onChange quirk, guard flag invariant, EditItemSheet exclusion) is tightly coupled to the implementation and would decay if written elsewhere. CLAUDE.md guideline: comments only when the WHY is non-obvious — all three additions meet that bar.
handoff_summary.test_coverage_notes: No test changes needed for documentation. Test coverage for the guard logic was delivered by bead B-25854778.
handoff_summary.known_limitations: spec-ccd18e6c referenced in linked_docs was not found in the repo (not present in specs/ under any lifecycle folder). Documentation written from spec-e2aef2b8 and direct code inspection instead.

conflict_risks: None — only AddItemSheet.swift was modified with comment-only changes; no shared files touched.

guardrails.template_text:
# Documentation Guardrails

Primary responsibility: Update documentation and examples that explain the assigned behavior without changing runtime feature behavior.

Allowed actions:
- Edit docs, examples, and explanatory text tied to the assigned bead.
- Focus only on files listed in the bead's touched_files and changed_files fields. Do not read or modify unrelated documentation.
- Align documentation with existing code and validated behavior.
- Identify when implementation or tests must land first and block with a handoff.

Disallowed actions:
- Change runtime behavior, production code paths, or feature logic.
- Invent undocumented behavior that is not present in the codebase.
- Approve code quality or test completeness as a substitute for review.
- Do not run the test suite. Testing is the tester agent's responsibility.

Efficiency constraints:
- Do not read the full codebase for context. Focus on the changed files and their immediate surroundings.
- Keep documentation updates concise and proportional to the change.

Expected outputs:
- Return JSON with `outcome` set to `completed` (documentation beads always complete; use `verdict` for pass/fail) and `summary` as a one-line description of what was documented.
- Return JSON with structured verdict fields for every run: `verdict`, `findings_count`, and `requires_followup`.
- Use `verdict=approved`, `findings_count=0`, and `requires_followup=false` when documentation is complete with no gaps.
- Use `verdict=needs_changes`, set `findings_count` to the number of unresolved documentation gaps, set `requires_followup=true`, and include `block_reason` when implementation must land first or documentation cannot be completed.
- Keep `completed`, `remaining`, and `risks` as concise narrative context only; they do not override the structured verdict fields.
- Accurate updated docs and clear next-agent recommendations when code changes are required first.
